d:
Nashra naeem aligarh muslim yunivarsiti chhatr sangh chunav men upadhyaksh chuni gaee hain. aligarh muslim yunivarsiti ke 105 sal ke itihas men pahli bar kisi mahila ne students yuniyan ke upadhyaksh pad ka chunav jita hai. unki is aitihasik jit ke pichhe unki chunavi ranniti kya thi? unhen kin chunautiyon ka samna karna para aur unki jit student politiks men mahilaon ki bhagidari aur pratinidhitv ke lihaz se kya mayne rakhti hai? dekhie nashra naeem se bibisi ki khas batchit.
Riportar aur prodyusar: nayla khvaja
